item.title: Assumption deputies: Woman arrested for cruelty to juvenile, 15-month-old treated for facial fractures
item.description: PAINCOURTVILLE - A woman was arrested for cruelty to a juvenile after her 15-month-old child had multiple facial fractures and was malnourished, the Assumption Parish Sheriff's Office said.Detectives responded to a complaint on Nov. 8 and learned that a 15-month-old child was being treated for bruising and leg and arm injuries. item.title: State Rep. Julie Emerson drops out of U.S. Senate race following Trump's endorsement of Letlow
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Louisiana State Rep. Julie Emerson dropped out of the U.S. Senate race for Bill Cassidy's seat following President Donald Trump's endorsement of Rep. Julia Letlow.In a statement on social media, Emerson said with Letlow's entrance into the race, "the path to victory that was visible a couple months ago has diminished." She said she supports President Trump and "respect[s] his decision to endorse" Letlow.Emerson announced her entrance into the race in Oct. 2025.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Port Allen Police trying to identify suspect who left victim with 'serious injuries' after altercation
item.description: PORT ALLEN - The Port Allen Police Department is trying to identify a suspect in a "violent physical altercation."The altercation happened Thursday, leaving a victim seriously injured and taken to a local hospital.Anyone with information regarding the incident or the identity of the suspect is urged to call officials at 225-343-5525.Permalink| Comments

item.title: LSU women's basketball handles Texas A&M in College Station
item.description: COLLEGE STATION, Texas - The LSU women's basketball team ended its road trip Thursday night with a big win over Texas A&M.The Tigers were in cruise control all evening, handling the Aggies from the start en route to a 98-54 win.MiLaysia Fulwiley led LSU with 23 points. item.description: BATON ROUGE - City leaders are helping residents manage their gas bills ahead of freezing temperatures coming to the capital region.Metro Council members partnered with Delta Utilities to host a town hall at the Doctor Leo S.
